Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id. Filter by assay CHEMBL1614455. Filter to exact measurements: standard_relation is '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Return all matching activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
